recommendations.location_hint: ## N6 Verdict — section A, 'The verdict, and what a kill would require'
recommendations.existing_text: A kill requires four conjuncts simultaneously, in an offline or fixed-dataset setting: **(a)** surrogate **model class** varied across at least two genuinely distinct classes; **(b)** optimizer or search routine varied across at least two routines; **(c)** the two axes genuinely **crossed**, every surrogate run with every optimizer; **(d)** a **two-way variance decomposition** of the outcome — an attribution of variance to each axis and their interaction — rather than a leaderboard. Conjunct (a) matters
recommendations.rationale: These four conjuncts are the definitional spine every ledger row, kill test and near-miss verdict in the report refers back to by letter, and the author will re-consult them repeatedly — as bullets they are addressable at a glance instead of parsed out of a semicolon run.

recommendations.location_hint: ## (iii) Scope of Novelty — RANK 1, 'Four reasons it is major rather than technical'
recommendations.existing_text: Four reasons it is major rather than technical. **(1) It is the strongest available vindication of N6.** The entire case for a crossed factorial over one-factor-at-a-time is that OFAT cannot estimate interactions — a point the standard reference states in the paper's own notation: *"OFAT experimentation leaves us in the dark about factor interactions,"* and under an interaction the optimal setting of one factor *reverses* depending on the other's level [58]. Every near-miss in the ledger is structurally incapable of producing this number. **It is the answer to "why did anyone need to run this?"** **(2) It reframes the optimizer null, the paper's weakest passage.**

recommendations.location_hint: ## What I could not verify and why — section G, 'Corrections this audit made to itself'
recommendations.existing_text: Each time a finding of this audit was tested, it weakened. (1) The 7/7 raw-units result was promoted as the audit's strongest finding, then demoted when the Styblinski data point supported the floor-effect alternative. (2) The normalization alarm was raised on Griewank-30D's outlier spread; the recomputation found Griewank is the *smallest* lever on the headline. (3) The RaM ground-(2) defence was falsified for four of the nine methods by RaM's own appendix. (4) "Nobody owns acquisition-stalling" was withdrawn in favour of Yarotsky as closest prior art [24]. (5) The conformal proposition was initially recorded as missing a hypothesis; reading the supplement directly showed it is formally correct, and the severe framing was withdrawn. **(6) The interaction ordering `surrogate > interaction > optimizer` was asserted "without exception" on the strength of a sweep that had only ever tested `η²_surr > η²_opt`. Run directly across four corners × three normalizers, it holds in 11 of 12 and inverts in one; the absolutism is struck and the 11-of-12 form reported instead.** That is the same defect class this audit convicts the paper of throughout — a warrant that does not cover the claim attached to it — committed in the audit's own lead recommendation. **(7) The two positive findings were paired on "each survives exactly what the other fails." The interaction's normalizer-immune form is the same measurement as the raw-units attenuation, and a perturbation floor effect would generate an interaction of that shape, so the pairing is FALSIFIED and replaced by one asymmetry seen two ways.** **(8) The RaM method-axis η² was offered as independent evidence for ground (1); because that axis is bundled methods, which this report's own conjunct (b) rejects as a clean factor, the inference is FALSIFIED and the figure is now reported as a bare cross-grid observation.** Separately, the paper's characterisation
recommendations.suggested_replacement:
Each time a finding of this audit was tested, it weakened.

- **(1)** The 7/7 raw-units result was promoted as the audit's strongest finding, then demoted when the Styblinski data point supported the floor-effect alternative.
- **(2)** The normalization alarm was raised on Griewank-30D's outlier spread; the recomputation found Griewank is the *smallest* lever on the headline.
- **(3)** The RaM ground-(2) defence was falsified for four of the nine methods by RaM's own appendix.
- **(4)** "Nobody owns acquisition-stalling" was withdrawn in favour of Yarotsky as closest prior art [24].
- **(5)** The conformal proposition was initially recorded as missing a hypothesis; reading the supplement directly showed it is formally correct, and the severe framing was withdrawn.
- **(6) The interaction ordering `surrogate > interaction > optimizer` was asserted "without exception" on the strength of a sweep that had only ever tested `η²_surr > η²_opt`. Run directly across four corners × three normalizers, it holds in 11 of 12 and inverts in one; the absolutism is struck and the 11-of-12 form reported instead.** That is the same defect class this audit convicts the paper of throughout — a warrant that does not cover the claim attached to it — committed in the audit's own lead recommendation.
- **(7) The two positive findings were paired on "each survives exactly what the other fails." The interaction's normalizer-immune form is the same measurement as the raw-units attenuation, and a perturbation floor effect would generate an interaction of that shape, so the pairing is FALSIFIED and replaced by one asymmetry seen two ways.**
- **(8) The RaM method-axis η² was offered as independent evidence for ground (1); because that axis is bundled methods, which this report's own conjunct (b) rejects as a clean factor, the inference is FALSIFIED and the figure is now reported as a bare cross-grid observation.**

Separately, the paper's characterisation
recommendations.rationale: Eight distinct self-falsification records — the report's credibility ledger — are currently fused into one ~2,400-character block where items (6), (7) and (8) each carry a FALSIFIED verdict the author must be able to find; every word, including all three verdicts, is preserved verbatim as bullets.

recommendations.location_hint: ## (iii) Scope of Novelty — the 'Explicitly `NOT-WORTH-IT`' paragraph at the end of section B
recommendations.existing_text: **Explicitly `NOT-WORTH-IT`.** Adding meta-commentary citing the venue's own review criteria *into the paper* — it reads as reviewer-gaming and the argument is stronger on the merits. Hunting further for an owner of the LCB-paralysis claim, since Yarotsky is a scoping obligation rather than an owner [24].
